text: Malaysia's Home Ministry banned Indra Sinha's Tantra: the Search for Ecstasy, gazetted on 2017-09-28 (P.U. (A) 278) under the Printing Presses and Publications Act. The ministry banned 22 publications in total, saying their contents could be detrimental to public order, alarm the public, breach existing laws, damage public morals and harm public interest. Its secretary-general, Alwi Ibrahim, said the ban on Tantra was because it contained explicit drawings and images of sexual positions that offended virtuous values and social mores in Malaysia.
